**Trigger Handler** · Custom Object · Stores which classes to run in response to DML performed on an object.

| `hed__Object__c` | Object | Text |  | The name of the object the class should act on, for example, Account, Contact, Opportunity. |
| `hed__Owned_by_Namespace__c` | Owned by Namespace | Text |  | The namespace of the package or Org that controls this Trigger Handler. |
| `hed__Trigger_Action__c` | Trigger Action | MultiselectPicklist | values: BeforeInsert, BeforeUpdate, BeforeDelete, AfterInsert, AfterUpdate, AfterDelete, AfterUndelete | The context in which this class should run, for example, before a record is inserted, after a record is deleted, etc. |
| `hed__User_Managed__c` | User Managed | Checkbox |  | When selected, we no longer push updates to this Trigger Handler. Select this option if you've made changes that you don't want us to overwrite. |
| `hed__Usernames_to_Exclude__c` | Usernames to Exclude | TextArea |  | Semicolon separated list of Salesforce usernames that this trigger will NOT run for. Leave blank to run for all users. |
